facts.fact: Vercel's own testing claims that prompts following its framework produce generation 30-40% faster, with less unnecessary code and fewer credits spent.
facts.quote: From our testing, good prompts consistently deliver: Faster generation time (30-40% faster with less unnecessary code, fewer credits spent)

facts.fact: Vercel says its team built hundreds of applications while developing the v0 prompting guidance.
facts.quote: After building hundreds of applications ourselves and learning from v0's power users

facts.fact: The v0 prompting guide was published on 15 December 2025 by Esteban Suárez, DevRel at v0.
The article is listed as a 4-minute read.
In Vercel's test example, the context-of-use prompt targets a fashion e-commerce audience of millennials aged 25-35 who browse on mobile during commutes.
facts.unit: years old (age range of example target audience)
